اشعاننت (form XI)

# اِشْعَانَنْتَ (išʕānanta) /iʃ.ʕaː.nan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِشْعَانَّ (išʕānna)
# اِشْعَانَنْتِ (išʕānanti) /iʃ.ʕaː.nan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِشْعَانَّ (išʕānna)
